title: Mrs. Newman Wolson

page_data.en:
1069

September 6 41.

Dear Sir,

With reference to your letter dated
28th August, 1941, I have to inform you that
there is no record in the Shanghai Municipal
Police concerning Mrs. Newman-Wolfson, 706 Route
Vallon, and nothing is known to her detriment.

Yours faithfully,

W. Duncan.
Assistant Commissioner
(Special Branch)

J. Alexander, Esq.,
Office of the Press Attache,
British Embassy,
Shanghai.

L 9 #

1941年9月6日。

敬启者：

关于阁下1941年8月28日的来信，兹告知，上海公共租界工部局警务处并无关于居住在瓦隆路706号的纽曼-沃尔夫森夫人（Mrs. Newman-Wolfson）的记录，亦未闻有任何对其不利之事。

此致

W. 邓肯
助理总监
